tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Live weather for any place on earth, including the radar echo drawn as text characters: current conditions and air quality, a short forecast, a 2-hour rain sparkline, a character radar map with the measured motion of the echo, and the next 24 hours and 5 days. Each reply also carries the radar map a

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_weather" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Live weather for any place on earth, including the radar echo drawn as text characters rather than an image: current conditions, a short forecast, a 2-hour rain sparkline, and a character radar map with the measured motion of the echo." → after: "Live weather for any place on earth, including the radar echo drawn as text characters: current conditions and air quality, a short forecast, a 2-hour rain sparkline, a character radar map with the measured motion of the echo, and the next 24 hours and 5 days. Each reply also carries the radar map a"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
